summary:
No decision was reached. 3 open questions, 1 open blocker, and no one took an explicit position on an option.

SUMMARY
No decision was reached. 3 open questions, 1 open blocker, and no one took an explicit position on an option.

## The main point

Jessica Wakefield shared an initial two-page draft summarizing Alpha Evolve's progress and the path forward for evaluating it, intended for a presentation to Ratnakar (RL). Wakefield asked Guruprasad Parab to confirm his team's accomplishments from the past week were accurately represented, and asked Sangeetha Somayajula to confirm she was comfortable with the definitive timelines; neither has confirmed in the thread. Sommer Hoffman said the presentation could not go to the originally planned meeting due to Corporate Services classification, and proposed October 14th at 10:30 AM ET as a new slot with RL. Monisha Somji drew a distinction between Wednesday's Alpha Evolve progress update and a broader always-on learning AI strategy covering Alpha Evolve, Auto-Research, and System 1, and proposed keeping Wednesday focused only on Alpha Evolve's progress, key learnings, and potential, while targeting end of October for the broader recommendations; Somji asked Sommer, Jessica, Maddy, and Vikram for their perspectives on this proposed separation, and no reply from those four is recorded.

## Open questions

- Whether and when to present Alpha Evolve progress to Ratnakar, and in what format (raised by Jessica Wakefield).
- Whether System 1 thinking should be combined with the discussion under consideration (raised by an unidentified sender).
- Which self-improvement and optimization criteria should be used (raised by an unidentified sender).

## Where people stand

- Monisha Somji: wants to keep the Alpha Evolve progress update separate from the broader always-on learning AI model strategy; proposes end of October for the broader assessment and recommendations to RL; asked Sommer, Jessica, Maddy, and Vikram for perspectives ahead of Wednesday.
- An unidentified sender said "I am good with how you are thinking about it" and "I would not combine System 1 thinking here," proposing to "narrow down to self-improvement and criteria for optimization."
- Duncan Quirk, Ilan Poonjolai T, Maddy Vasantham, Monique Smith, Nagaraju Vellala, Vikram Bandugula: no explicit position recorded.

## What is blocking progress

- Proposed focus for Wednesday's Alpha Evolve update is awaiting input from Sommer, Jessica, Maddy, and Vikram (raised by Monisha Somji).

## Next steps

- Jessica Wakefield asked Guruprasad Parab to confirm the team's accomplishments from the past week are accurately represented in the draft; no reply recorded.
- Jessica Wakefield asked Sangeetha Somayajula to confirm she is comfortable with the definitive timelines; no reply recorded.
- Sommer Hoffman said she would work with Joanna to find exclusive time, and sent a calendar invite to all for October 14th at 10:30 AM ET with RL.

## Awaiting a reply

- Jessica Wakefield asked Guruprasad Parab to confirm his team's accomplishments are accurately represented; no reply recorded.
- Jessica Wakefield asked Sangeetha Somayajula to confirm she is comfortable with the definitive timelines; no reply recorded.
- Monisha Somji asked Sommer Hoffman, Jessica Wakefield, Maddy Vasantham, and Vikram Bandugula for their perspectives on the proposed Wednesday focus; no reply recorded from any of them.

## Things people asserted that others may want to check

- An unidentified sender said self-improving agents/systems by nature require deep thinking and proposed experimentation.
- Jessica Wakefield said Ratnakar wants the group to stay closely aligned with progress to date on Alpha Evolve.
- Monisha Somji said the broader assessment (Alpha Evolve, Auto-Research, and System 1) is targeted for end-of-October delivery to RL.
